title: The beat launches each device's groundloop/pulse.py
intention: Each beat, the ground loop launches every device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop/pulse.py as a separate process it does not wait on, and its one JSON record lists each device found with its pulse.py's path, mtime and pid, or NOT FOUND.
why: Akien 2026-10-19: 'the post commit hook shall not call pulse. pulse shall be called from the pulse emitted by the ground loop, that IS the system deamon.' and his outline (~/.akien/20261017.CairnComponentOutlineV1.txt lines 29-30): the ground loop 'launches a script in each device's cairn/cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop called pulse.py'. Measured 2026-10-19: the loop writes liveness every 60 s and reaches nothing; ticket 164da559823d (2026-10-05) deleted the launcher and all eight pulse files, so counting_block's pulse() moved onto the post-commit hook. The charter's filed edge (b) has stood open since: 'still open: the loop spawns the pulse to its two listeners'.
traces_to: the ground_loop charter's filed edge (b) and falsifier (5) 'what it spawned' / (6) 'the loop waiting on what it spawned'; telos aim 1 (one clock, its listeners spawned, never hosted); Law 4 (one heartbeat is physics)
how: heartbeat.py gains spawn_pulses(class_root, held) -> (entries, held): walk the rack tool's folders (cairn.tools.rack.rack(class_root), sorted); a folder with no groundloop/pulse.py appends {device, pulse: 'NOT FOUND'} and spawns nothing; first poll() every handle in held and drop the finished ones (no zombies, never blocks); then for each path Popen([sys.executable, str(path)], cwd=class_root, env=os.environ + PYTHONPATH=class_root, stdin/stdout/stderr=DEVNULL, start_new_session=True) and append {device, path, mtime, pid}; an OSError appends {device, path, error} and the next path is still spawned. __main__.py calls it once per beat and writes the entries under a new state key 'spawned' ([] on beat 0). No import of any pulse.py, no wait, no skip or overlap logic, no bus, no shim, no probe.
falsifier: Proof cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_the_beat_spawns_each_device_pulse.py runs the loop in a subprocess (cadence 0.5 s) over a scratch instance root and a scratch class root holding devices alpha (pulse.py appends its pid to a marker file), beta (pulse.py sleeps 30 s), gamma (pulse.py raises) and delta (no groundloop/pulse.py). RED if: (1) alpha's marker holds fewer than 2 pids after 3 beats; (2) the beat count does not advance past 3 within 5 s while beta sleeps (the loop waited); (3) a liveness record's 'spawned' lacks an entry for alpha, beta or gamma, or any of those entries lacks device+path+mtime+pid; (4) delta is not listed exactly once as pulse 'NOT FOUND', or carries a pid; (5) gamma raising stops alpha being spawned on a later beat. The test kills the loop and every spawned pid at the end.
builder_notes: Q: which proof teeth of 164da559823d change? A: test_the_beat_calls_nothing.py — tooth 1 drops its */groundloop/pulse.py assertion (beat_probes.py stays forbidden); tooth 2 drops its 'no pulse called' half and keeps 'no triggers key'; _STATE_KEYS gains 'spawned'; each change cites open-a322e5166e5d. Q: charter? A: ground_loop intention+why.json 'what' item (4) and filed edge (b) say the loop spawns each device's pulse.py; written through the artifact door. Q: interpreter? A: sys.executable. Q: which roots? A: class_root as main() already receives it (rack_ids(class_root)); None means repo_root() from discovery.py.

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/heartbeat.py add `import os`, `import subprocess`, `import sys` (heartbeat.py already has `from pathlib import Path` at its top, measured 2026-10-19; keep it) and the function `spawn_pulses(class_root, held=None) -> tuple[list[dict], list]`: `root = Path(class_root)`; `still = [h for h in (held or []) if h.poll() is None]` (reap, never wait); `env = {**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(root)}`; for each `path` in `sorted((root / 'cairn' / 'devices').glob('*/groundloop/pulse.py'))` build `entry = {'device': path.parent.parent.name, 'path': str(path)}`, then `subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(path)], cwd=str(root), env=env, stdin=DEVNULL, stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL, start_new_session=True)`; on OSError set `entry['error'] = f'{type(err).__name__}: {err}'` and go on to the next path, else set `entry['pid'] = child.pid` and append the handle to `still`; return `(entries, still)`. Never import a pulse.py, never wait, no skip/overlap/timeout logic. Do not use the names Triggers, pulse_sites, load_pulse or beat_probes anywhere (test_the_beat_calls_nothing.py tooth 4). — CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'

D2: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py extend the existing absolute import line `from cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.heartbeat import changed, mtimes, own_files` to also import `spawn_pulses`, and add `from cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.discovery import repo_root` (discovery.py:62 defines `def repo_root() -> Path`, measured 2026-10-19; __main__.py already has `from pathlib import Path`); set `pulse_root = Path(class_root) if class_root is not None else repo_root()` and `held: list = []` before the loop; the beat-0 state written before the loop carries `'spawned': []`; each beat inside the loop calls `spawned, held = spawn_pulses(pulse_root, held)` before building state and adds `'spawned': spawned` to the state dict. Update the module docstring: the beat launches each device's groundloop/pulse.py as a detached child (ticket 81eb3e46aed9) instead of 'it calls nothing'; drop 'no pulse calls' from the 'No bus, ...' line and say pulses are launched, never called in-process. — CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'

D3: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_the_beat_calls_nothing.py, citing Akien's answer to open-a322e5166e5d: tooth 1 keeps only the beat_probes.py assertions (drop the `*/groundloop/pulse.py` tracked check); tooth 2 drops `assert not marker.exists()` (its fixture's on_pulse marker) and keeps the exact key set; `_STATE_KEYS` gains 'spawned'. Leave PROVES keys and test names unchanged. — CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'

D4: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/intention+why.json (copy the charter JSON to a scratch file, edit the two strings there, then land it with `bin/cairn artifact write cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/intention+why.json --verb cast --why '81eb3e46aed9: the loop launches each device pulse.py' --from <scratch file>`; never write the charter path directly), 'what' item (4) becomes 'launches each device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop/pulse.py as a separate process it does not wait on, with no skip or overlap logic, and records what it spawned (ticket 81eb3e46aed9; 164da559823d had retired the in-process pulse calls)'; filed edge (b) becomes DONE: 164da559823d deleted the in-process calls, 81eb3e46aed9 restored the launch as detached child processes. Falsifiers unchanged. — CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'

D5: SETTLED, supersedes D1's glob and D2's repo_root: Akien's outline (V1 line 251, V2 5.5.3.5) has the record list EACH device: 'beat time, found device (folder), NOT FOUND or name, file mtime, pid it spawned'. The ticket cast 2026-10-19 from V1 lines 29-30 missed it. spawn_pulses walks cairn.tools.rack.rack(class_root) (the rack tool's public interface; None is the repo), lists a folder with no pulse.py as {device, pulse: 'NOT FOUND'}, and adds mtime to every launched entry; __main__ passes class_root straight through, so no repo_root import. Proof teeth (3) and (4) amended to match before any seal (test names renamed with them). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 (measurement settles proof shape) and his outline, which outranks the ticket.

D6: the proof cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_the_beat_spawns_each_device_pulse.py ALREADY EXISTS, committed (709b1a4f red-first, amended e98d279e to the outline record); its 5 teeth are the falsifier's (1)-(5) one to one, PROVES keyed '1'..'5'. Do not create or rewrite it; the build only makes it green.

D7: spawn_pulses body, exactly: still = [h for h in (held or []) if h.poll() is None]; for device, folder, _shim in rack(class_root): path = folder/'groundloop'/'pulse.py'; entry = {'device': device}; append entry; if not path.is_file(): entry['pulse'] = 'NOT FOUND'; continue; entry['path'] = str(path); cwd = class_root or folder.parents[2]; try: entry['mtime'] = path.stat().st_mtime; child = Popen([sys.executable, str(path)], cwd, env PYTHONPATH=cwd, DEVNULL x3, start_new_session=True) except OSError as err: entry['error'] = f'{type(err).__name__}: {err}'; continue; entry['pid'] = child.pid; still.append(child). Return (entries, still). rack is imported from cairn.tools.rack.rack.
